title: Unary decrementing run invariant
statement: Let $P$ be a register program with oracle $	ext{oracle} : 	ext{decider indices}	imes	ext{Boolean words}	o	ext{Boolean answers}$, let $r$ be a register, and let $dD,dL,dE,dB,	ext{next}$ be states. Assume that for every input symbol and tuple of work-tape symbols, the transition from $dD$ is the decrement action determined by the symbol read on register $r$, the transition from $dL$ is the leftward-decrement action determined by that symbol, the transition from $dE$ is the clearing action, and the transition from $dB$ is the increment action determined by that symbol. Assume there are no oracle calls at $dD,dL,dE,$ or $dB$. For every initial configuration $c$, Boolean words $w,	ext{pre}$ with $w$ canonical (every nonempty canonical word ends in $1$), there are a time $T$ and a head position $p$ such that $-1\\le p < |\text{pre} \mathbin{+} \mathrm{decW}(w)|$ and the run from state $dD$, with register $r$ storing the word $	ext{pre}\mathbin{+}w$ and its head at $|	ext{pre}|$, reaches state $dB$ with register $r$ storing $	ext{pre}\mathbin{+}\mathrm{decW}(w)$ and its head at $p$. At every time $t<T$, the run is in one of the states $dD,dL,dE$, and the head position $q$ satisfies $|	ext{pre}|\le q\le|	ext{pre}\mathbin{+}w|$.
